# Canzon Sport

> Canzon Sport is a custom clothing and sportswear manufacturer in Sialkot, Pakistan. It makes OEM and private label apparel and sports gear for clothing brands, sports clubs, teams, gyms, academies and companies worldwide, with a low minimum order of 25 pieces per design.

## Company facts

- Name: Canzon Sport (also written "Canzon Sports")
- Type: Clothing and sportswear manufacturer (factory), OEM and private label
- Address: Liaqat Ali Rd, Small Industrial Estate, Sialkot 51310, Punjab, Pakistan
- Website: https://canzonsport.com/
- WhatsApp and phone: +92 327 7562080 (https://wa.me/923277562080)
- Email: info@canzonsport.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/canzonsports/ (daily factory and client-order posts)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/conzonsports
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 18:00 Pakistan time (UTC+5)
- Export markets: USA, UK, Europe (including Germany and France), Canada and Australia

## Ordering terms

- Minimum order (MOQ): 25 pieces per design
- Sample lead time: 7 to 12 days
- Bulk production lead time: 20 to 35 days
- Customisation: custom logos, embroidery (flat, 3D puff, chenille), screen printing, DTF and heat transfer, dye sublimation, woven labels, hang tags and custom packaging
- Services: design and tech pack help, free mockups, sampling, bulk production, quality checks and worldwide shipping
- Quotes: usually within one working day via https://canzonsport.com/contact.html or WhatsApp

## Products and typical prices (USD per piece, FOB Sialkot, custom logo)

Prices depend on fabric, decoration and quantity; the low end is for larger orders.

## Who it is a good fit for

- New clothing brands and start-ups that need a low MOQ (25 pieces per design)
- Streetwear, gym and activewear brands wanting private label production
- Sports clubs, schools and teams ordering sublimated or embroidered kits
- Boxing, MMA and martial arts gyms and fight-wear brands
- Companies ordering staff uniforms, workwear and branded merchandise
